description: Create apps/api: Fastify 4 TypeScript server with /health endpoint, Zod environment variable validation, Pino structured logging with secret redaction, MongoDB connection via Mongoose, CORS, global error handler, and one passing Vitest test. Server starts successfully and connects to MongoDB.
steps: Create apps/api/package.json with name @orbit/api, type: module, main: ./dist/index.js, scripts: dev (tsx watch src/index.ts), build (tsc), test (vitest), start (node dist/index.js); dependencies: fastify, @fastify/cors, @fastify/cookie, mongoose, pino, pino-pretty, zod, dotenv; devDependencies: tsx, typescript, vitest, @types/node; workspace dependency: @orbit/shared: workspace:*
Create apps/api/tsconfig.json extending ../../packages/config/tsconfig.base.json with compilerOptions: outDir ./dist, rootDir ./src, module: NodeNext, moduleResolution: NodeNext

Create apps/api/.env.example with all required variables: NODE_ENV=development, PORT=4000, PUBLIC_WEB_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5173, MONGODB_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017/orbit, REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379, JWT_ACCESS_SECRET=change-me-in-production, JWT_REFRESH_SECRET=change-me-in-production, COOKIE_SECRET=change-me-in-production, MAX_USERS=2

Create apps/api/src/config/env.ts with Zod schema validating all environment variables (z.object with z.string(), z.number().int(), z.enum(['development', 'production', 'test'])); parse process.env and export typed config object
Create apps/api/src/utils/logger.ts initializing Pino with redact: ['config.jwtAccessSecret', 'config.jwtRefreshSecret', 'config.cookieSecret'], prettyPrint in development
Create apps/api/src/db/mongoose.ts with connectDB async function: mongoose.connect(config.mongodbUri), log success/error, handle connection events

Create apps/api/src/routes/health.ts defining GET /health route handler returning { status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), version: process.env.npm_package_version || '0.1.0' }; validate response with HealthResponseSchema from @orbit/shared
Create apps/api/src/plugins/cors.ts registering @fastify/cors with origin: config.publicWebOrigin, credentials: true
Create apps/api/src/plugins/error-handler.ts with global error handler logging errors and returning standardized JSON error responses
Create apps/api/src/app.ts creating Fastify instance with logger, registering plugins (cors, error-handler), registering routes (health), exporting buildApp function
Create apps/api/src/index.ts importing config, logger, connectDB, buildApp; call connectDB(), build app, listen on config.port, log server ready message
Create apps/api/vitest.config.ts with test environment: node, test glob patterns
Create apps/api/src/__tests__/health.test.ts testing GET /health returns 200 with correct shape matching HealthResponseSchema
Run `pnpm --filter @orbit/api build` to verify TypeScript compilation
Run `pnpm --filter @orbit/api test` to verify tests pass
acceptance_criteria: Environment variables are validated on startup; missing required vars cause process to exit with clear error
GET /health returns 200 with { status: 'ok', timestamp: ISO8601 string, version: string }
MongoDB connection succeeds and logs success message
Pino logger redacts secrets from logs
Global error handler catches unhandled errors and returns JSON
At least one Vitest test passes
verification: Start MongoDB with Docker Compose (see FEAT-006) or local installation
Run `pnpm --filter @orbit/api dev` and verify server starts without errors
Use curl or browser to GET http://localhost:4000/health - returns 200 with correct JSON
Check terminal logs for MongoDB connection success message
Verify logs do NOT contain JWT_ACCESS_SECRET or other secrets
Stop server, run `node apps/api/dist/index.js` with env vars - server starts
